title: Resolve G9 or obtain a documented waiver

comments.author: ADMIN
comments.text:
PART (a) COMPLETE 2026-10-16 -- verified, not assumed. tests/regress_g9_part_a_complete.py (19) re-derives from the recovered image: MS Shell Dlg 8pt (not Tahoma 9), 3x RichEdit50W, the control ids, 17 controls, and the port's DU->px 595x753. COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX's stale 'app.py:318 sizes to 526x366' corrected.

PART (b) BLOCK REASON CHANGED -- it was arm64-Darwin/no-wine, which is no longer true. Host is AMD64 Windows with SysWOW64, and the installed QTranslate.exe is the SAME 1,462,272-byte PE32 -- so native IS runnable here via WoW64. The block is now the operator's screenshot ban (policy), not capability.

REMAINING: a waiver needs a human to write it -- the validator never assigns one, and Gate arithmetic depends on that. This bead cannot be closed by an agent.

title: Verify the tray X:/Y: cursor readout against native before changing UI
Phase 7: split App into the 6 window classes (needs explicit go-ahead)

comments.author: ADMIN
comments.text:
PORT HALF DONE 2026-10-16 -- 'publish UI extension slots; migrate theme/panel/menu/popup extension points'. qtranslate/ui_slots.py publishes all three kinds with names derived from native (menu ids from the locale pack's Menus[].Id, panels from the three Show*Pane toggles), wired into ExtensionManager.register_ui / ExtensionAPI.register_ui with the same declared-replaces conflict policy as providers and themes. tests/regress_ui_slots.py (26).

REMAINING, and it is the part that needs a go-ahead: splitting App into MainWindow/OptionsDialog/HistoryView/DictionaryView/TrayController/PopupHost. The user has twice said the UI is settled ('UI đã có, tham khảo rồi'), and the screenshot ban removes the verification signal for a restructure. Doing it blind would be a large unverifiable refactor.

title: Phase 8: choose a bundler and produce Win/macOS bundles

comments.author: ADMIN
comments.text:
D17 DONE 2026-10-16 -- 'the extension vendors its own deps' is now exercised end-to-end on a real filesystem, not just bookkept. tests/regress_extension_vendored_dep.py (11): the vendored import resolves during load, the folder leaves sys.path, the dep is not left under its plain name (the collision name a second extension would use), the entrypoint stays namespaced qtranslate_ext_<id>_<mod>, a broken extension raises with built-ins intact.

REMAINING, and only that: the BUNDLER CHOICE plus a real bundle. That is a product decision (PyInstaller vs Nuitka vs cx_Freeze, and whether macOS is even a target) which an agent should not make alone -- the plan records it as 'not asked yet'. Once decided, the loader/wiring already landed so a bundle only has to ship the Core runtime.
